prompts.title: Review a product
prompts.body: Review the supplied product brief and prototype. Identify the three most consequential usability problems. For each, include a reproduction path, user impact, and a concrete correction. Distinguish observations from assumptions.

prompts.title: Plan a small release
prompts.body: Turn the supplied goal into a small, testable release. Define the intended outcome, included changes, acceptance checks, and unresolved decisions. Flag dependencies that can block delivery.

prompts.title: Return an update
prompts.body: Summarize the work completed, link the artifact, describe the checks actually run, and state the next action. If a decision is needed, give concrete options and a recommendation.

tasks.title: Review the Apollo prototype
tasks.doneWhen: Three findings have reproducible steps and a proposed correction.
tasks.context: Use the product review skill and project brief.

notes.title: Make the next step clear
notes.body: Prefer one obvious next action. Keep the evidence nearby.
